ayahs.1: Abu Lahab ke dono haath toot gaye aur woh (khud) halaak ho gaya.
ayahs.2: Na to us ka maal us ke kaam aaya aur na us ki kamai.
ayahs.3: Woh anqareeb bharakne wali aag mein jaaye ga.
ayahs.4: Aur us ki biwi bhi (jaaye gi,) jo lakdiyan dhone wali hai.
ayahs.5: Us ki gardan mein post khajoor ki bati hui rassi hogi.
